findings.claim: The Claude harness does not contain exactly the 14 manifest roles because extra Claude agent files remain installed.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion “Role coverage” requires each of the five locations contain exactly the 14 role definitions; the packet file_tree states “.claude/agents: 16 entries” and “.claude/agents also holds fhir-ideation-strategist.md and fhir-knowledge-curator.md”.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove or retire the two non-roster Claude agent files in this change, or make the installer/check fail until `.claude/agents/` contains exactly the manifest roster.

findings.claim: The cross-harness lint does not enforce exact roster membership for Claude agents, so the current extra Claude files are not caught by CI.
findings.evidence: The HARNESSES roster/extra-file loop covers only codex/opencode/kimi/minimax via `for (const [name, spec] of Object.entries(HARNESSES))`, while Claude is handled later only by checking each roster id exists and has generated sections: `for (const id of roster) { ... .claude/agents/${id}.md ... }`; acceptance criterion requires `.claude/agents/` contain exactly the 14 role definitions and lint fail on drift across all harnesses.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Claude to the exact roster check, or explicitly enumerate `.claude/agents/*.md` and fail for any file whose id is not in the manifest.

findings.claim: The install drift check is not byte-for-byte because it normalizes CRLF before comparing installed files to fresh exports.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion “Generated files are not hand-edited” says drift must fail on any byte difference; `normalize = (buf) => buf.toString("utf8").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")` is used in `const same = existsSync(to) && normalize(readFileSync(to)) === normalize(want)` and marker comparisons.
findings.suggested_fix: Compare raw Buffer contents for generated files and markers in `--check`; rely on `.gitattributes` for line-ending consistency instead of normalizing differences away.

findings.claim: The AGENTS.md drift check is not byte-for-byte because it normalizes CRLF before comparison.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion “Generated files are not hand-edited” says drift must fail on any byte difference, but `--check` uses `readFileSync(out, "utf8").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n") !== want`, so a CRLF hand edit or checkout change is accepted.

findings.claim: AGENTS.md generation changes the document title in addition to the harness-specific lead line.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion “Non-Claude harnesses get project instructions” requires AGENTS.md be generated from CLAUDE.md “changing only the harness-specific lead line”; `agentsMd()` returns ``# AGENTS.md\n${src.slice(CLAUDE_TITLE.length + 1).replace(CLAUDE_LEAD, AGENTS_LEAD)}``, replacing the `# CLAUDE.md` title as well.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve the original title if the criterion is literal, or update the acceptance criteria to explicitly allow changing the title.
